ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $5.00 no-show fee; no refund to rider. Optionally remind the driver of the contact-attempt duty (already satisfied: 2 chats + 1 call) and close the case.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen first: the complaint, the driver's statement and both chat messages contain no threat, harassment, sexual remark, dangerous-driving allegation or accident. Nothing triggers SAFE-1/SAFE-2; safety_concern = none.

This is a driver-cancelled no-show (F4: app reason rider_no_show; F14 driver statement confirms "no rider, so I cancelled"), so NS-1/NS-2 govern (NS-0). All four NS-1 conditions hold on the system records:
(i) Arrival: the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 18:25:55 while 40 m from the pickup point and the platform auto-recorded arrival at the same minute [F6][F7]; closest GPS approach 38 m [F1] — well inside the 200 m radius.
(ii) Free wait: the 5-minute free wait is counted from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival. The driver stayed within 200 m for 5 min 10 s, and was stationary at the pickup point 18:25:55–18:31:05 (5 min 10 s), cancelling 8 min 5 s after acceptance [F2][F3][F4][F6][F7]. That exceeds 5 minutes; no separate threshold is in the record.
(iii) Contact attempts: before cancelling the driver sent 2 in-app messages (first 18:26:25) and made 1 in-app call (18:27:25, unanswered) [F5][F10][F11][F13] — satisfies the ≥1 message AND ≥1 call requirement.
(iv) Continuous presence: GPS shows the driver within 200 m from 18:24:55 through cancellation with no gap [F2][F3][F7].
The rider's assertion that the driver "never even called" [complaint] is contradicted by the call log [F13], and the GPS/timeline records override statements, so it does not defeat the fee. No NS-2 failure, and no NS-8 situation (driver did arrive). Fee of $5.00 stands [F8]; no surge is involved [F9]. Driver profile [F19] and rider profile [F18] are not used to decide the case; no RD-6/NS-9 repeat clause is triggered by the current facts. Precedent DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel, zero contact, $5.00) is distinguishable only on contact attempts, both reaching the same outcome of an upheld fee. TH-2 makes no-show/cancellation system-final at the fixed $5.00.
